newsitem.title: USA: Corporate bond calendar unruffled by US rate climb.
newsitem.headline: Corporate bond calendar unruffled by US rate climb.

text.p: Despite a recent uptick in U.S. Treasury yields, names continue to be tossed around in the corporate bond primary market as anxious investors await the offerings, dealers said.
"Based on the names I'm hearing it doesn't look like people are shying away from the market...there's quite a calendar building," one syndicate source said.
Among deals expected on Tuesday is Polaroid Corp's $250 million issue, rated Baa3/BBB, via lead manager Lehman Brothers, syndicate sources said.

Baxter International Inc is expected to tap the market with a $500 million two-part debt offering via Goldman Sachs & Co. The A3/A rated deal is expected to consist of a $250 million 10-year issue and $250 million in 30-year debt, sources said.
Merrill Lynch and Co Inc is expected to issue $350 million in Aa3/AA-minus rated 10-year debt for itself, sources said.
Orion Capital Corp, Markel Corp and USF&G Corp are all expected to tap the market with trust preferred deals near-term, sources said,
